summary: The document outlines a technical assessment for a frontend developer at VectorShift, requiring implementation of JavaScript/React for the frontend and Python/FastAPI for the backend. The assessment includes four parts, with specific requirements for the Text node logic (dynamic sizing and variable insertion) and backend integration. The frontend must run using npm i and npm start, while the backend uses uvicorn main:app --reload. The document emphasizes collaboration between frontend and backend, with detailed instructions for code modifications and testing.
topics: Text Node Logic (Dynamic Sizing & Variable Insertion)
